# Grid402

> Hub de microservicos e dados abertos para agentes autonomos de IA e aplicacoes M2M sob o protocolo HTTP 402 com liquidacao em USDC na rede Base.

## Core Documentation
- [Full LLM Context](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/llms-full.txt): Documentacao exaustiva com schemas JSON e contratos de endpoints para modelos de linguagem
- [Central de Agentes de IA](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/agents): Guia rapido de integracao para agentes autonomos, Claude Desktop, Python e cURL
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/openapi.json): Especificacao completa e interativa da API no padrao OpenAPI 3.1
- [MCP Server Card](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Ficha de descoberta de capacidades SEP-1649 para servidores MCP
- [MCP Well-Known Manifest](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/.well-known/mcp.json): Manifesto estruturado com a lista de ferramentas MCP do Grid402
- [AI Plugin Manifest](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): Manifesto padrao para plugins e descoberta por motores de IA
- [Oracle Verifier API](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/verify): Endpoint sem estado para validacao criptografica de provas de oraculo em menos de 1 ms
- [Status e Saude do Hub](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/status): Verificacao de disponibilidade e resumo operacional dos servicos
- [Sobre a Organizacao](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/about): Missao, arquitetura Zero-DB e endereco institucional
- [Canais de Contato](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/contact): Suporte tecnico, encarregado de dados DPO e telefonia
- [Termos de Servico](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/terms): Condicoes de uso, licenca MIT e termos M2M
- [Politica de Privacidade](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/privacy): Diretrizes de privacidade, conformidade LGPD e retencao de logs

## Public Micro-Services APIs
- [Forex Rates API](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/forex): Cotacoes cambiais oficiais de USD, EUR e GBP para BRL em tempo real
- [Crypto Tickers API](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/crypto): Precos de mercado spot de BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC e BASE
- [DNS Records Lookup](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/dns?domain=base.org): Resolucao autoritativa de registros A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS e CNAME
- [TLS and SSL Inspector](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/ssl?host=base.org): Inspecao e auditoria de certificados TLS e SSL na porta 443
- [ASN and BGP Intelligence](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/asn?ip=1.1.1.1): Roteamento BGP, bloco alocado e numero ASN de IPs
- [CEP Postal Address API](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/cep?code=01310100): Resolucao de endereco postal brasileiro e codigo municipal IBGE
- [CNPJ Corporate Registry API](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/cnpj?cnpj=00000000000191): Dados cadastrais de Pessoa Juridica na Receita Federal
- [Economic Indicators API](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/indicators): Taxas oficiais Selic (meta e diaria), CDI anual e diario, IPCA 12m e mensal (BCB e IBGE)
- [National and Banking Holidays API](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/holidays?year=2026): Calendario oficial de feriados nacionais e bancarios (ANBIMA e Febraban) com calculo matematico Meeus
- [ANBIMA Workdays Calculator API](https://orangered-jackal-900744.hostingersite.com/api/v1/workdays): Calculadora de dias uteis bancarios ANBIMA com contagem de intervalo e projecao de prazos

## SDKs and Agent Frameworks
- [Python SDK (PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/grid402/): Pacote oficial grid402 para Python com suporte a Pydantic e Coinbase AgentKit
- [Node.js and TypeScript SDK (npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/grid402): Pacote oficial grid402 no npm com suporte hibrido ESM e CommonJS
- [Model Context Protocol Server (npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/grid402-mcp): Servidor MCP oficial para Claude Desktop, Cursor e Smithery
- [Coinbase AgentKit Providers](https://github.com/oliveiratc/Grid402/tree/main/integrations/agentkit): Provedores de acoes com autoliquidacao on-chain para carteiras CDP

## Micropayment Protocol Details
- Rede e Chain ID: Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453)
- Tarifa Padrao por Requisicao: 0.0005 USDC (CNPJ: 0.0020 USDC)
- [Base Mainnet Scanner](https://basescan.org/address/0xa31c31069c43ac1c0075a93c325b0dcd7744356c): Carteira oraculo recebedora de micropagamentos (0xa31c31069c43ac1c0075a93c325b0dcd7744356c)
- [USDC Contract on Base](https://basescan.org/token/0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913): Contrato oficial de USDC na rede Base Mainnet (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)

## Cryptographic Proof of Data (Verifiable Oracle)
- Todas as respostas tecnicas liberadas com pagamento on-chain ou modo Sandbox incluem a chave `_oracle_proof`.
- Atestacao: Assinatura digital ECDSA secp256k1 e hash SHA-256 do payload canonico, permitindo que agentes de IA e contratos inteligentes verifiquem localmente a autenticidade dos dados da carteira oraculo (0xa31c31069c43ac1c0075a93c325b0dcd7744356c).
- Endpoint de Verificacao: `POST /api/v1/verify` (ou `GET /api/v1/verify?payload=...`) valida sem estado qualquer resposta com assinatura em menos de 1 ms via motor OpenSSL em C (limite maximo de 64 KB). Retorna `valid: true/false`, `payload_hash`, `oracle_address`, `timestamp` e `verification_time_ms`.
